Policies and Initiatives.title: Cabinet approves policy on AI, eyes over Rs 10,000 cr investment, 1.5 lakh jobs by 2031
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The cabinet has approved a policy on artificial intelligence, aiming to attract over Rs 10,000 crore in investment. The policy targets creating 1.5 lakh jobs in the AI sector by 2031. This initiative is expected to drive significant growth and development in India's AI industry.

Policies and Initiatives.title: ‘Data over dynasties’: Grok supports Modi govt over Congress’ dynastic politics
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Grok AI has sparked debate with its response to a hypothetical political preference question, appearing to favour the data-led governance of PM Narendra Modi's government over the Congress party's dynastic politics. The AI highlighted development metrics such as infrastructure growth, Digital India, and economic rise to support its stance. This has ignited a discussion around the idea of "data over dynasties" in Indian politics.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Apr 20 - Apr 25]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian startups raised around $47 million in funding this week, with 13 early-stage deals and 6 undisclosed transactions. This is a significant decrease from the previous week, which saw 17 startups secure around $129.07 million. The largest early-stage deal was secured by healthcare automation startup Coral, which raised $12.5 million from Z47 and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Policies and Initiatives.title: KRAFTON, Naver officially launch Rs 6,000 Cr India Unicorn Growth Fund with Mirae Asset
Policies and Initiatives.summary: KRAFTON Inc. and Naver Corporation have partnered with Mirae Asset Venture Investments to launch a Rs 6,000 crore India-focused Unicorn Growth Fund. The fund, announced in December, is one of the largest capital pools raised from Asia for Indian startups. The official launch was attended by high-level government officials, including Union Minister Piyush Goyal and South Korea's Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources Jung Kwan Kim.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Centre forms high-level inter-ministerial body to steer AI governance strategy
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India has formed a high-level inter-ministerial body called AIGEG, headed by Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, to guide the nation's AI governance strategy. AIGEG will coordinate policies across ministries and regulators, and assess AI's impact on the labor market. The group will develop a roadmap for AI deployment over the next decade.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Brandworks Technologies Signs MoU with MeitY Startup Hub to Boost AI-Led Electronics...
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Brandworks Technologies has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with MeitY Startup Hub to promote AI-led electronics manufacturing. The partnership aims to foster innovation and growth in the electronics sector through artificial intelligence. This collaboration is expected to boost the development of AI-driven electronics in India.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Govt forms high-level AI governance panel to steer policy framework; Vaishnaw to lead
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government has formed a high-level inter-ministerial body, the AI Governance and Economic Group (AIGEG), to oversee the country's artificial intelligence policy framework. Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw will lead the panel, which will serve as the central institutional mechanism for AI governance, policy development, and coordination. The AIGEG aims to steer India's AI policy framework, with MeitY constituting the group.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Memory chip shortage due to AI buildout, not West Asia conflict, says IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw attributes the memory chip shortage to the AI buildout, rather than the West Asia conflict. The Indian government is actively promoting semiconductor manufacturing, with the Prime Minister inaugurating the country's first semiconductor plant last month and another one scheduled for next month. This indicates a positive approach by the government towards addressing semiconductor concerns.

Policies and Initiatives.title: UP govt scraps Rs 25,000-crore MoU with Puch AI: ‘Firm lacks net worth, financial linkages’
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has canceled a Rs 25,000-crore Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Puch AI due to the company's lack of net worth and financial linkages. The decision was made after reviewing the firm's financial capabilities, which were deemed insufficient to support the massive investment. The scrapped MoU was initially intended to facilitate a significant investment in the state.

Policies and Initiatives.title: IndiaAI Mission onboards 38,231 GPUs, 190 projects approved: Jitin Prasada
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's IndiaAI Mission has onboarded 38,231 GPUs and approved 190 projects to enhance the country's artificial intelligence ecosystem. The mission aims to strengthen the nation's AI capabilities. Additionally, the Semicon India Programme has cleared 10 semiconductor units to promote domestic chip manufacturing.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Mar 16 - Mar 21]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian startups raised around $330.2 million in funding this week, with 6 growth-stage deals securing $272.1 million and 20 early-stage deals securing the remaining amount. This represents a significant increase from the previous week, when 22 startups collectively secured about $162.98 million. The total funding this week was distributed across 26 Indian startups.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Mar 09 - Mar 14]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian startups raised around $162.98 million this week, with 6 growth-stage and 16 early-stage deals. This amount surpasses the $105.08 million secured by 14 startups in the previous week. Growth-stage startups accounted for the majority of the funding, raising $120.3 million.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: $240 billion investment pledged by top firms
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Top firms including Reliance Industries, Google, and Tata Group pledged $240 billion in investments at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. Over $200 billion of this investment will target AI infrastructure, hardware, and applications. The summit drew 6 lakh attendees from 100 countries, aiming to strengthen India's sovereign compute capacity and national AI infrastructure.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Govt weighs new cyber framework as Airtel unveils AI Threat Research Centre
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is planning new cybersecurity laws to combat AI-powered threats. Airtel has unveiled an AI Threat Research Centre in partnership with Zscaler to monitor and combat these threats. The centre will track 500 billion daily transactions to identify potential security risks.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India unveils frontier AI commitments to drive measurable outcomes
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India has announced a voluntary framework to drive AI adoption, focusing on transparency and multilingual capabilities. The framework aims to promote measurable outcomes in AI development and usage. The move is part of the government's efforts to sharpen its regulatory approach to artificial intelligence.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Centre plans market platform for AI startups in next mission phase: MeitY
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) plans to create a market platform for AI startups as part of its next phase. This move comes after the ministry's first large-scale AI initiative, which will inform next year's plans through incorporated feedback on challenges faced. The initiative is part of the IndiaAI Mission, led by Abhishek Singh, additional secretary of MeitY.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India pitches inclusive AI roadmap to the world
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India has introduced a voluntary AI roadmap that promotes inclusive and responsible development. Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled guidelines that encourage signatories to achieve measurable outcomes in these areas. The initiative aims to push for a more equitable approach to AI development globally.

Policies and Initiatives.title: PM Modi presents ‘MANAV Vision’ framework for AI at India AI Impact Summit 2026; flags deepfake threat
Policies and Initiatives.summary: PM Modi presented the 'MANAV Vision' framework for AI at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, emphasizing a human-centric approach with a focus on ethics and accountability. The framework aims to address the threat of deepfakes and promote trust in artificial intelligence. It prioritizes data sovereignty and watermarking norms to ensure responsible AI development.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India giving necessary policy backing to accelerate AI, semiconductor push, highlights MeitY Secretary
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is entering a crucial phase in its semiconductor and AI development, driven by sustained policy support and long-term investments. The government aims to build sovereign capabilities in these areas through competitive compute pricing and strategic investments. Secretary of MeitY S. Krishnan highlighted the importance of policy backing in accelerating India's AI and semiconductor push.

Policies and Initiatives.title: IndiaAI Mission join hands with Coursera to offer ‘YUVA AI for ALL’ foundational course on AI
Policies and Initiatives.summary: IndiaAI Mission has partnered with Coursera to offer a free foundational AI course called "YUVA AI for ALL" to equip citizens with essential artificial intelligence skills. The course covers AI applications, safety, and ethics, and learners will receive a government certificate upon completion. This initiative supports India's goal of becoming an AI-enabled nation.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Indian govt issues new AI content rules for social media, sets 3-hour takedown window
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government has introduced new rules for social media platforms regarding AI-generated content, requiring them to use automated tools to detect and prevent its circulation. Platforms must take down such content within a 3-hour window. The revised framework aims to regulate the spread of illegal AI-generated content on social media.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India's sovereign AI model strategy delivering results
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's sovereign AI model strategy is yielding positive results, according to Union Electronics and IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. He praised a homegrown startup, Sarvam AI, for releasing an advanced AI model. The success of this strategy highlights the potential of India's domestic AI development efforts.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India-US interim trade deal to boost access to advanced GPUs, data centre equipment
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India and the US are finalising an interim trade framework to increase access to advanced GPUs and data centre equipment. The agreement aims to create opportunities for startups, service providers, and the AI ecosystem. This trade deal is expected to boost India's access to critical technologies, according to Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Agnihotri bats for drone, robotics push at tech fest
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Deputy CM Agnihotri emphasized the need for IIIT Una to focus on drone technology and robotics at a tech fest. He praised the institution's skill development courses and new MSc mathematics program, and MoUs were signed to enhance academic and research collaboration. Agnihotri also stressed the importance of technology fairs and government support for a thriving digital ecosystem.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Next-Gen chips, real-world challenges: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's second-phase semiconductor mission, India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, aims to achieve globally competitive outcomes. The mission must match industry readiness with scaling to turn mega-fabs and rare earth plans into reality. According to IESA President Ashok Chandak, this is crucial for the mission's success.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India Offers Zero Taxes Until 2045 to Lure Global AI Firms
Policies and Initiatives.summary: As the global race to build AI infrastructure accelerates, India has offered foreign cloud providers zero taxes through 2047 on services sold outside the country if they run those workloads from Indian data centres. This is expected to accelerate India's rise in the AI space.

Policies and Initiatives.title: New Panel To Review Impact Of AI On Services Sector: Nirmala Sitharaman
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is taking precautions to protect its rapidly expanding workforce from the ill-effects of AI's slow takeover. This new panel is a high-powered Education to Employment and Enterprises Standing Committee that will recommend measures that focus on services sector as a core driver of economic growth.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Budget 2026 signals AI-led growth, skilling push; industry calls for faster execution
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026 aims to drive growth through AI and skilling initiatives, with a focus on emerging sectors. Key initiatives include the India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 and industry-led research centres. The budget also proposes setting up AVGC content creator labs in schools and colleges to promote employment in these areas.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India's AI and semiconductor foray marks crucial shift in employment landscape
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's foray into AI and semiconductor sectors marks a significant shift in the employment landscape, requiring a highly skilled workforce for top roles. Reskilling and upskilling are necessary to tap into the domestic talent pool. Close coordination with the industry ecosystem is crucial to achieve this.

Policies and Initiatives.title: How AI is helping researchers revive cultural heritage; Explained
Policies and Initiatives.summary: AI is aiding researchers in reviving cultural heritage through digitization efforts. In India, over 10 crore pages of historical documents are now available online via the Abhilekh Patal portal, a significant milestone in heritage preservation. This digital archive is a result of the National Archives' prioritization of digitization to make cultural heritage more accessible.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 60% of businesses confident in scaling AI, but gaps remain: Nasscom Report
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian businesses are increasingly adopting Responsible AI, with 30% having mature practices and 45% implementing formal frameworks, marking a significant increase from 2023. Despite 60% of businesses being confident in scaling AI, challenges such as hallucinations and privacy concerns persist. Businesses with higher AI maturity are better prepared for emerging technologies, but require framework updates for advanced AI systems.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Dell, NxtGen to build 'India’s largest AI training cluster' under sovereign cloud
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Dell and NxtGen are collaborating to build India's largest AI training cluster under a sovereign cloud project. The project will utilize over 4,000 NVIDIA GPUs to enhance domestic AI computing capabilities. This initiative aims to support enterprises, startups, academia, and government entities.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI’s Copyright Reckoning: Can India Balance Creators And Code?
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Copyright holders, including Hollywood studios and book publishers, are resisting AI training due to concerns over intellectual property rights. This pushback is part of a larger debate about balancing the interests of creators with the development of AI code. India is now faced with the challenge of finding a balance between these two competing interests.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI-led upskilling creates new pathways for women in India’s STEM ecosystem
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Women's STEM education in India is growing, with AI-led upskilling creating new tech roles. Despite this, women's presence in the workforce, particularly in manufacturing and electric mobility, remains low. Bridging the education-to-employment gap through internships and inclusive workplaces is crucial for long-term growth.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 'India in 1st league of AI nations, not a follower': IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw at Davos; focus on deployment over large models
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has declared the country a leader in artificial intelligence, rather than a follower. He emphasized a focus on deploying AI on a large scale, prioritizing practical implementation over developing massive AI models. This approach positions India as a major player in the global AI landscape.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 60% AI-ready Firms Mature on Responsible AI, Gaps Persist: Nasscom Report
Policies and Initiatives.summary: A Nasscom report finds that 60% of AI-ready firms have matured in their adoption of responsible AI, but gaps persist. Key challenges include data quality, regulatory uncertainty, and hallucinations, which hinder the advancement of responsible AI frameworks. Despite progress, these gaps must be addressed for further growth and development.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Tech an enabler, future success will rely on strong base of trust: Nasscom VP on AI governance
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Nasscom VP Aggarwal views technology as a great enabler, believing AI can be used to minimize and prevent harms generated by its use. There is a growing emphasis on setting "technology-led guardrails" to mitigate potential issues. This approach prioritizes proactive measures over reactive regulations in AI governance.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI adoption to generate $1.7 trillion for India by 2035: KPMG report
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's adoption of artificial intelligence is expected to generate $1.7 trillion in economic value by 2035. This growth will be driven by investments in semiconductors, strong data governance, and rapid adoption across various sectors. A KPMG report released at the World Economic Forum in Davos forecasts this significant economic boost.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India to See Up To $150 Bn AI Infrastructure Investments in 2026: Ashwini Vaishnaw
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the country is expected to see significant investments in AI infrastructure, potentially reaching up to $150 billion in 2026. This investment is part of India's escalated AI ambitions, as stated at the World Economic Forum. The large-scale investment aims to boost India's AI capabilities and infrastructure.

Policies and Initiatives.title: “Not Second Tier”: Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw Defends India’s AI Ambition at Davos
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's approach to artificial intelligence was highlighted at the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting in Davos. Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw defended India's AI ambition, emphasizing its significance on a global scale. Vaishnaw's statement aimed to establish India as a major player in the AI sector, dispelling any notion of it being "second tier".

Policies and Initiatives.title: Artificial intelligence: Reshaping global markets and opening India’s next growth frontier
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming global equity markets, driven by US tech firms. India is emerging as a key AI infrastructure growth hub due to supportive policies, abundant talent, and increasing data centre investments. This development is poised to unlock India's next growth frontier amidst rising valuation concerns in the global market.

Policies and Initiatives.title: GLC and Schoolnet India conclude EcoInnovators Ideathon 2026 on AI for sustainability
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The EcoInnovators Ideathon 2026, a national student innovation challenge, concluded with grand finales for its school and college tracks, focusing on Artificial Intelligence for sustainability. The initiative is recognized by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology as a pre-summit event of the IndiaAI Impact Summit 2026. The event was organized by the Global Learning Council in partnership with Schoolnet India and other companies to empower India's youth to develop AI-based solutions.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI will define next phase of India’s digital growth: DoT Secretary
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Artificial intelligence will drive India's next phase of digital growth, according to DoT Secretary Amit Agrawal. India is committed to responsible AI development and ASEAN digital cooperation, with a focus on rapid telecom expansion and digital public infrastructure. The country is also implementing capacity-building initiatives to support this growth.

Policies and Initiatives.title: A Timely Pivot: How GenAI Allowed SpeakX To Find A New Edtech Mission
Policies and Initiatives.summary: SpeakX, an edtech company, has found a new mission thanks to the capabilities of GenAI. The company is leveraging AI to improve English language skills in India, where English proficiency is highly valued. GenAI has enabled SpeakX to pivot and expand its offerings in the edtech space.

Policies and Initiatives.title: X Corp acknowledges obscene Grok AI content, assures compliance with Indian law
Policies and Initiatives.summary: X Corp, run by Elon Musk, has acknowledged the presence of obscene content generated by its Grok AI chatbot. The company has assured compliance with Indian laws after government action was taken. Thousands of posts were blocked and hundreds of accounts were deleted in response to a directive from India's MeitY.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Why India organisations need federated data management
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India aims to achieve a trillion-dollar digital economy by 2030, driven by artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things. To support this goal, federated data management is crucial as it enables efficient data access and analysis, reducing costs and enhancing security. This approach is vital for India's digital future and supports AI development.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Global leaders & top tech executives to attend AI summit
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Global leaders and top tech executives will attend an AI summit, with around 100 executives from tech firms and ministers from approximately 50 countries participating. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will address the event, including a leaders plenary and a CEO roundtable. The summit will bring together key figures from around the world to discuss AI.

Policies and Initiatives.title: How National Deep Tech Startup Policy can Help Start a New Era in Innovation
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is home to over 3,000 deep-tech startups, focusing on innovations in areas like AI, big data, and blockchain, with potential to contribute $450-500 billion to the economy by 2025. These startups are transforming industries such as agriculture, life sciences, and aerospace with novel technology solutions. A national deep tech startup policy can help foster the growth of this emerging sector, driving innovation and economic growth.

Events.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: PM Modi to lead opening ceremony - Important entry protocols, traffic advisory for February 19
Events.summary: PM Modi will lead the opening ceremony of the India AI Impact Summit 2026 on February 19 at 9:40 AM. The ceremony will also be addressed by the President of France, the Secretary-General of the United Nations, and top industry leaders. The event is scheduled to take place on February 19, with specific entry protocols and traffic advisories in place.

Events.title: AI Impact Summit 2026: PM Modi hails India as rising global AI powerhouse, calls it a defining moment
Events.summary: India is hosting the India AI Impact Summit Expo 2026, which PM Modi sees as a defining moment for the country's AI leadership. The event will focus on human-centric AI progress and global collaboration for a progressive future. India is being hailed as a rising global AI powerhouse at the summit.

Events.title: GBS 2026: India to host world’s largest AI summit; AI to drive ‘Fifth Industrial Revolution,’ says Ashwini Vaishnaw | ET NOW Global Business Summit 2026
Events.summary: India will host the world's largest AI summit, GBS 2026, with over 20 heads of state and 100 global leaders in attendance. The summit will focus on AI's transformative impact, sovereign models, and the shift from IT services to AI-driven capabilities. AI is expected to drive the 'Fifth Industrial Revolution', according to Ashwini Vaishnaw.

Events.title: Delhi to get major facelift as NDMC steps up preparations for upcoming India-AI Impact Summit
Events.summary: The New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) is preparing for the upcoming India-AI Impact Summit by giving Delhi a major facelift. The preparations are part of the city's efforts to host the summit, which is expected to bring significant attention to the city. Delhi's infrastructure and amenities will be upgraded as part of the facelift.

Events.title: Capital One India: Driving innovation with a country-wide Hackathon and AI Summit
Events.summary: Capital One India is hosting a nationwide hackathon and AI summit to drive innovation and address real-world challenges. The event aims to bring together talent, technology, and purpose to build solutions. The hackathon and summit will provide a platform for participants to showcase their skills and creativity.

Events.title: India–AI Impact Summit 2026
Events.summary: The India–AI Impact Summit 2026 is an upcoming event focused on artificial intelligence. Details about the summit, including its agenda and speakers, are not provided in the given content. The event is expected to discuss the impact of AI on various sectors in India.

Events.title: Digital India Ask Our Experts | Episode 41 | India AI Impact Summit 2026
Events.summary: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is hosting an episode of "Digital India Ask Our Experts". This episode, numbered 41, aims to discuss AI's impact in India. The summit brings together experts to share knowledge and insights on AI's role in India's digital transformation.

Major AI Developments.title: The agentic pivot: Reimagining Bharat’s growth through automated intelligent agency
Major AI Developments.summary: India is leading global digital transformation, moving beyond AI experimentation to autonomous collaboration. Enterprises are adopting goal-driven AI agents that execute resolutions, shifting from passive AI assistants. This shift requires re-architecting business processes with event-driven workflows, integrated data, and robust trust frameworks to drive growth.

Major AI Developments.title: (AI)IMS bridging gaps in Indian autism care
Major AI Developments.summary: AIIMS is working to improve autism care in India by making it more accessible and affordable through the use of smartphones, remote platforms, and low-cost AI-assisted systems. The goal is to move parts of care into the home, reducing the need for costly and difficult-to-sustain hospital visits. This approach aims to bridge gaps in Indian autism care, particularly for those who face financial and geographical barriers to therapy.

Major AI Developments.title: How AI-led deflation is dragging Indian IT firms but spurring innovation
Major AI Developments.summary: AI-driven deflation is impacting Indian IT firms, with an estimated 3.5% industry deflation. This is leading to weaker-than-expected growth guidance due to a timing lag in new programme ramp-ups. Mid-tier players are seen as better positioned than larger incumbents in the current market.

Major AI Developments.title: Exfinity Venture Partners exits partially from CloudSEK
Major AI Developments.summary: Exfinity Venture Partners has partially exited its investment in cybersecurity platform CloudSEK, achieving a 13x multiple on invested capital and an internal rate of return of over 40%. The partial exit was executed as a secondary sale to existing investors, with Exfinity retaining a meaningful ownership stake in the company. Exfinity was CloudSEK's first institutional investor, backing the company during its pre-Series A round.

Major AI Developments.title: Amazon rides AI growth wave; ultra-fast delivery surges in India
Major AI Developments.summary: Amazon's profit increased 77% to $30.3 billion, driven by strong growth in its cloud computing segment, AWS, which accounts for about 60% of earnings. The company's heavy investment in AI and chip growth supported this cloud-led growth globally. Amazon's focus on AI has contributed to its significant profit surge.

Major AI Developments.title: Piper Serica leads Rs 10 Cr seed round in AIoT startup Ubiqedge
Major AI Developments.summary: Ubiqedge, a full-stack AIoT startup, has raised Rs 10 crore in a seed funding round led by Piper Serica. The funds will be used to enhance AI capabilities, scale deployments across various industrial use cases, and expand its network of partners. Ubiqedge aims to build an operating system for industrial infrastructure with its hardware platform KLEON.

Major AI Developments.title: From understanding AI to leading with it
Major AI Developments.summary: Most Indian enterprises have accepted the importance of AI, but are struggling to implement it in practice. The main challenge is determining how to effectively utilize AI in daily operations. Indian boardrooms are now focused on finding ways to lead with AI and drive transformation.

Major AI Developments.title: We committed $100 billion to build a platform that supports India’s AI...
Major AI Developments.summary: A significant investment of $100 billion has been committed to developing a platform that supports India's artificial intelligence ecosystem. This substantial investment aims to foster growth and innovation in the country's AI sector. The platform is intended to provide a comprehensive support system for India's AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: Optimized Electrotech: India’s AI electro-optical systems
Major AI Developments.summary: Optimized Electrotech is developing AI-powered electro-optical systems for defense applications in India. The company has received Rs 100 crore in funding to support its efforts. Its systems are already being used by Indian forces, marking a significant milestone in the country's defense technology advancements.

Major AI Developments.title: HyugaLife raises $10.5 Mn in Series A round led by IvyCap Ventures
Major AI Developments.summary: HyugaLife, a marketplace for proteins and supplements, has raised $10.5 million in a Series A funding round led by IvyCap Ventures. The round also saw participation from First Bridge Fund, adding to the company's previous seed round of $6.3 million in February 2024. The funding brings HyugaLife's total raised capital to $16.8 million.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s financial sector eyes ‘productivity revolution’ through Agentic AI
Major AI Developments.summary: India's financial sector is shifting from basic AI automation to a more advanced agentic AI model to boost productivity. Top executives believe that integrating autonomous agents into operations is crucial for growth. This transition is expected to drive a "productivity revolution" in the Indian financial services industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Indian IT’s big boys admit concerns around AI-led deflation
Major AI Developments.summary: Top Indian IT companies, including Tata Consultancy Services and Infosys, have expressed concerns about AI-led deflation impacting their revenues. The CEOs of these companies, such as HCL Technologies and Wipro, have acknowledged the issue in recent weeks. They have also discussed the potential benefits of higher productivity resulting from AI adoption.

Major AI Developments.title: AI to accelerate India's tech industry, not a threat; tech to continue hiring people
Major AI Developments.summary: Srikanth Velamakanni has taken over as the top leader of NASSCOM amidst challenges facing the Indian IT industry, including geopolitical turmoil and AI disruption. According to Velamakanni, AI is expected to accelerate India's tech industry rather than pose a threat. The tech industry is likely to continue hiring people despite the emergence of AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Gartner survey reveals 80% of CEOs say AI will force operational capability overhauls
Major AI Developments.summary: A Gartner survey found that 80% of CEOs believe AI will require significant overhauls of operational capabilities. By 2028, many organizations are expected to rely less on human intervention for decision-making, adopting more autonomous business models. AI is also anticipated to impact revenue streams through automated transactions and changing customer relationships.

Major AI Developments.title: Data centres must coexist with frugal AI in India, say experts at Frugal Innovation Forum
Major AI Developments.summary: Experts at the Frugal Innovation Forum discussed the need for data centres to coexist with frugal AI in India. The forum, which lasted two days, brought together innovators and policymakers from India and France. The event aimed to explore how achieving more with limited resources can drive a sustainable and inclusive future.

Major AI Developments.title: Before Mythos goes public, Indian IT also wants access
Major AI Developments.summary: Mythos, a powerful AI model, is expected to expose vulnerabilities in companies' infrastructure globally. Its developer, Anthropic, has delayed a wider launch and given early access to a select group of companies to fix their systems. Indian IT companies are now seeking access to Mythos to prepare for its potential impact.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s techade to be shaped by 6G, AI, quantum technologies: Dr Pemmasani...
Major AI Developments.summary: India's techade is expected to be shaped by emerging technologies such as 6G, AI, and quantum technologies, according to Dr. Pemmasani. These technologies will play a crucial role in defining the country's technological advancements. Dr. Pemmasani's statement highlights the significance of these technologies in India's future tech landscape.

Major AI Developments.title: Swiggy opens AI commerce stack to external developers with Builders Club
Major AI Developments.summary: Swiggy has launched the Builders Club, an initiative that allows external developers to access its AI commerce stack. This move aims to expand Swiggy's AI ecosystem by enabling outsiders to build new applications with real-life use cases. The Builders Club provides an opportunity for developers to create innovative solutions using Swiggy's AI technology.

Major AI Developments.title: FM flags AI risks, says banks ready for challenges
Major AI Developments.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that Indian banks are prepared to handle technological risks, but expressed concern over potential threats from Anthropic's Mythos AI. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology is monitoring the situation and advocating for stronger safeguards. Indian authorities are taking a cautious approach to mitigate potential risks associated with AI.

Major AI Developments.title: AI’s rapid rise forces India to rethink ‘light-touch’ regulations
Major AI Developments.summary: India is reevaluating its "light-touch" approach to AI regulations due to recent controversies. The need for tighter oversight arose after explicit AI-generated content was found on Grok, a chatbot embedded in social media platform X. This development has prompted India to consider stricter regulations to address concerns surrounding AI.

Major AI Developments.summary: AI drift is becoming a significant operational and business risk for Indian enterprises as AI becomes more integrated into daily workflows. This shift is transforming drift from a purely technical concern to a broader business issue. As a result, Indian companies must now consider the potential costs and implications of AI drift on their operations.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Summit draws $250B infrastructure commitments, $20B VC investments in deeptech
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Summit secured $250 billion in infrastructure commitments and $20 billion in venture capital investments in deeptech. The event drew over 5 lakh visitors, demonstrating significant domestic and global interest in India's AI initiatives. Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the summit's notable participation and investment figures.

Major AI Developments.title: Meet Ranvir Sachdeva: Youngest coder who addressed India AI Impact Summit 2026; meets Sundar Pichai, Sam Altman and other tech titans
Major AI Developments.summary: Ranvir Sachdeva, an 8-year-old coder, became the youngest speaker at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. He presented on how ancient Indian philosophy can influence modern Artificial Intelligence development. Sachdeva also met with prominent tech leaders, including Sundar Pichai and Sam Altman, at the summit.

Major AI Developments.title: AI and digital to power India’s CX industry growth to Rs 30.88 lakh cr by 2027: Report
Major AI Developments.summary: India's CX industry is expected to grow to Rs 30.88 lakh cr by 2027, driven by the expansion of digital CX solutions and integration of generative AI. The industry is shifting from cost-driven outsourcing to intelligence-led service delivery, with AI playing a key role in this transformation. The market is projected to remain resilient and substantial despite initial concerns of shrinkage.

Major AI Developments.title: India advances privacy-first, multilingual AI with handheld open hardware prototype
Major AI Developments.summary: India has developed a handheld open hardware prototype that supports multilingual AI queries, prioritizing user privacy by processing data on-device. The prototype is a result of collaboration with Digital India BHASHINI, Current AI, and Kalpa Impact. It aims to facilitate rural deployment and privacy-first AI applications.

Major AI Developments.title: 4 Youth Congress workers sent to 5-day police custody
Major AI Developments.summary: Four Indian Youth Congress workers were arrested for protesting at an AI Summit and sent to 5-day police custody. They were accused of raising anti-national slogans, wearing objectionable T-shirts, and violating prohibitory orders. The workers claimed they were peacefully protesting for employment, according to their defense.

Major AI Developments.title: Congress faces heat from several quarters over ‘shirtless’ protest at AI summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Youth Congress workers staged a "shirtless" protest at the India AI Impact Summit, sparking outrage from the BJP and other parties. The BJP accused the Congress of harming India's image and alleged "treason," with several IYC workers being arrested. The protest was widely condemned across multiple states.

Major AI Developments.title: India stands at AI inflection point amid infrastructure shift
Major AI Developments.summary: India is at a crucial point in its AI development, with the technology representing an infrastructure shift rather than just an upgrade. The "India AI Impact Summit 2026" brought together industry leaders and experts to discuss this shift. According to them, infrastructure determines power, making AI a key factor in India's future.

Major AI Developments.title: World leaders to declare shared stance on AI at India summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Dozens of world leaders and ministers are set to declare a shared stance on artificial intelligence at a summit in India on Friday. The declaration will conclude a five-day summit focused on the technology and its implications. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi noted that humans and AI systems are increasingly co-creating, co-working, and co-evolving.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s MSMEs are a “ton of gold” for AI, if startups crack the cost and language challenge
Major AI Developments.summary: India's MSMEs are seen as a key growth area for AI adoption, with cost-effective and linguistically diverse solutions needed to tap into this market. Leaders at the India AI Impact Summit 2026 discussed scaling AI adoption to benefit citizens and businesses nationwide. Successful AI deployments in India's MSME sector could offer inclusive models with global relevance.

Major AI Developments.title: At India AI Summit, Sam Altman says superintelligence could be here by 2028
Major AI Developments.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman predicts that superintelligence could arrive as early as 2028. He emphasized India's crucial role in shaping the future of AI during the India AI Summit. Altman also warned about the potential risks of power concentration associated with AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: General Catalyst to invest $5B in India over the next five years
Major AI Developments.summary: General Catalyst plans to invest $5 billion in India over the next five years, driven by optimism about the country's innovations. The firm has previously backed notable companies such as Canva, Zepto, and Anthropic. This investment is expected to support India's growing tech industry.

Major AI Developments.title: TATA Group and OpenAI forge foundational partnership to advance AI transformation in...
Major AI Developments.summary: TATA Group has formed a foundational partnership with OpenAI to drive AI transformation. The collaboration aims to advance AI capabilities, although specific details of the partnership are not provided. This alliance is expected to leverage OpenAI's expertise to propel TATA Group's AI initiatives forward.

Major AI Developments.title: New AI models tailored to address local needs in India, Global South:...
Major AI Developments.summary: New AI models are being developed to address local needs in India and the Global South. These models aim to provide solutions tailored to the specific requirements of these regions. The development of such models is expected to have a significant impact on the local communities by providing more relevant and effective AI solutions.

Major AI Developments.title: Reliance Group to invest Rs 10 lakh crore in AI, create new...
Major AI Developments.summary: Reliance Group plans to invest Rs 10 lakh crore in artificial intelligence (AI). The investment aims to create new opportunities and drive growth in the AI sector. This significant investment underscores the company's commitment to emerging technologies and innovation.

Major AI Developments.title: Tharoor breaks ranks, backs India’s AI summit as PM Modi charts global push
Major AI Developments.summary: Congress leader Shashi Tharoor supported India's Bharat AI Impact Summit, differing from his party colleagues Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge. Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the need for equitable access to AI, global consensus, and regulatory safeguards at the summit. The event is part of Modi's push for India to play a key role in the global AI landscape.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit: Meet ‘LuSI’, the ‘Made in India’ AI-integrated robotic baby revolutionising medical training
Major AI Developments.summary: The IITI DRISHTI CPS Foundation has unveiled "LuSI", a 2.5 kg robotic newborn with AI integration, designed to aid in medical training. LuSI, which stands for Lungs Simulator, is a realistic robotic baby that helps bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical clinical experience for doctors and students. This innovation is a "Made in India" product showcased at the AI Impact Summit.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: The case for small AI
Major AI Developments.summary: Tech leaders argue that small, task-specific AI models are more effective in resource-constrained settings, such as rural areas, due to their ability to function on basic phones and unreliable internet. These models are seen as more deployable in such areas, making them a viable alternative to massive AI models. Collective action is necessary for AI to successfully scale to remote regions, according to experts.

Major AI Developments.title: Sundar Pichai says India’s AI story can be extraordinary
Major AI Developments.summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai believes India has the potential for an extraordinary AI story, citing the country's significant role in shaping global products. Pichai emphasized the importance of the US-India partnership in shaping the next phase of AI development. He made these comments at the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

Major AI Developments.title: Razorpay’s Harshil Mathur bets on AI to make commerce conversational again
Major AI Developments.summary: Razorpay has launched Agentic Payments on Claude, a platform that allows users to make payments within a chat interface. This feature enables users to order from food delivery services such as Zomato, Swiggy, and Zepto through conversational commerce. The move aims to make commerce more conversational using AI technology.

Major AI Developments.title: India is going to lead in AI through entrepreneurship: General Catalyst’s Hemant Taneja
Major AI Developments.summary: General Catalyst's Hemant Taneja believes India will take the lead in AI through entrepreneurship. This statement was made during his keynote address at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. General Catalyst plans to invest $5 billion in India over the next five years, as announced a day prior to the summit.

Major AI Developments.title: US-India partnership has critical role to play to make AI benefits available to everyone: Sundar Pichai
Major AI Developments.summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai emphasized the importance of the US-India partnership in making AI benefits accessible to everyone. This statement came after his meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, where they discussed India's AI ambitions and Google's potential role. The partnership aims to accelerate India's AI development and transformation through talent development, digital infrastructure, and sectoral growth.

Major AI Developments.title: Indian AI Startup Tracker: 170+ Startups Putting India On The Global AI Map
Major AI Developments.summary: Over 170 Indian AI startups are making a mark on the global AI landscape, contributing to the country's growing presence in the industry. The Indian AI ecosystem has been gaining momentum, particularly after the launch of ChatGPT in late 2022, which brought AI into the mainstream. These startups are helping put India on the global AI map, showcasing the country's potential in the field.

Major AI Developments.title: Livspace lays off 1,000 employees amid co-founder exit and AI shift
Major AI Developments.summary: Livspace has laid off around 1,000 employees, approximately 12% of its workforce, as part of a reorganisation to become an AI-native organisation. The layoffs come amid a lack of external funding and uncertainty about the company's path to profitability. The actual number of affected employees may be as high as 25%, according to some reports.

Major AI Developments.title: Razorpay and NPCI bring agentic payments to Claude at India AI Impact Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Razorpay and NPCI have partnered to introduce Agentic Payments to Claude, enabling users to make purchases through AI. The platform, currently in its pilot phase, allows users to order essentials from services like Zomato and Swiggy without leaving the conversation. This integration brings payments directly into the AI experience, streamlining the shopping process.

Major AI Developments.title: AI will create new jobs even as it transforms roles: Vice President
Major AI Developments.summary: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan stated that artificial intelligence will create new job opportunities while transforming existing roles. India is strengthening its position in the global AI ecosystem, with AI having potential across key sectors. The India AI Impact Summit 2026 highlighted AI's potential and its impact on various industries.

Major AI Developments.title: Youth Cong protesters enter AI Summit venue using QR codes
Major AI Developments.summary: Youth Congress workers in India protested at the AI Impact Summit by registering as visitors and using QR codes to gain entry. They were subsequently arrested and charged with unlawful assembly and other offenses. The protest was held against perceived compromises of India's interests, prompting heightened security measures.

Major AI Developments.title: World Punjabi Conference deliberates on role of AI in preserving language
Major AI Developments.summary: Guru Nanak Dev University hosted the World Punjabi Conference to discuss AI's impact on the Punjabi language, culture, and society. A Rs 1 crore grant was announced for an Ethical AI Centre to promote the integration of AI with Punjabi. The conference aims to leverage AI while preserving Punjabi heritage and emphasizing ethical considerations.

Major AI Developments.title: India's AI stack rouses interest from African startups
Major AI Developments.summary: African AI startups are showing interest in India's AI stack due to its cost-effectiveness. India's subsidized GPU infrastructure offers costs 70% lower than Western providers, making it an attractive option for scaling localized solutions. This has led to African startups considering India as a viable alternative for their AI needs.

Major AI Developments.title: Agentic AI Era: Cloud security shifts from asset protection to identity-first zero trust
Major AI Developments.summary: The cloud security landscape is shifting from asset protection to identity-first zero trust due to the rise of agentic AI workloads. This change is driven by the need for faster detection and tighter control planes in response to identity compromise threats. Experts like Starbucks India CTO Nikhil Bhushan and Jio's Gaurav Duggal are advocating for a "shift-left" governance approach to address these challenges.

Major AI Developments.title: Can India lead the global AI race?
Major AI Developments.summary: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon believes India has the potential to lead the global AI race due to its scale, young population, and mobile ecosystem. He emphasized the importance of sovereign AI and hybrid architectures for context-aware agents. Qualcomm has launched a $150 million fund to invest in Indian AI startups, supporting the country's AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Summit: Ashwini Vaishnaw lays out five-layer strategy to power inclusive growth
Major AI Developments.summary: India is developing a five-layer strategy to promote inclusive growth through AI, focusing on democratizing technology and its benefits. The country is creating specialized AI models and investing in compute infrastructure to support this goal. India aims to become a trusted global AI hub, aligning its AI progress with overall development.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘MANAV’ Vision for AI: PM Modi calls for human-centric, transparent global framework
Major AI Developments.summary: PM Modi has introduced the "MANAV" vision for AI, emphasizing a human-centric approach. The framework aims to prioritize transparency and accountability in AI development and deployment. Modi is advocating for a global framework that aligns with these principles to ensure AI benefits society as a whole.

Major AI Developments.title: Google aiming to infuse AI at all levels in India: Sundar Pichai
Major AI Developments.summary: Google is planning to integrate AI across all levels in India, according to Sundar Pichai. This initiative aims to promote the use of artificial intelligence in various sectors. Sundar Pichai announced Google's goal to make AI more accessible in India.

Major AI Developments.title: Reliance announces $110 bn AI push; TCS seals deal with OpenAI
Major AI Developments.summary: Reliance Industries and Jio plan to invest $110 billion in an AI push, building India's sovereign compute infrastructure. The infrastructure will include multi-gigawatt AI-ready data centres and a nationwide edge network. Additionally, TCS has sealed a deal with OpenAI, further solidifying the AI initiative.

Major AI Developments.title: AI costs are dropping fast—and India stands to gain: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman
Major AI Developments.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated that decreasing computing and inference costs are making artificial intelligence more accessible. This trend is expected to benefit India, where AI can now be more widely adopted. Altman also downplayed concerns that AI would disrupt India's IT services industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Can India's AI talent bridge the gap between advanced tech and real-world enterprise adoption?
Major AI Developments.summary: India is a global hub for AI talent, with the number of professionals in AI roles expected to double by 2027. To achieve successful AI integration, companies must modernize their systems, curate data, and build confidence, as well as reskill their employees. India's experience in complex enterprise modernization makes it well-positioned to develop scalable AI solutions.

Major AI Developments.title: AI next big infrastructure like electricity, internet, must reach every citizen
Major AI Developments.summary: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran stated that artificial intelligence is the next major infrastructure that will significantly impact society. He compared AI's potential impact to that of transformative technologies like steam engines, electricity, and the internet. Chandrasekaran emphasized that AI must be accessible to every citizen to realize its full potential.

Major AI Developments.title: India fastest-growing market for OpenAI’s vibe coder Codex, Altman says
Major AI Developments.summary: India is the fastest-growing market for OpenAI's Codex, according to Altman. The country's rapid uptake of the technology is evidence of its increasing influence in shaping the next phase of AI deployment. This growth highlights India's emerging role in the global AI landscape.

Major AI Developments.title: Humans and AI will co-create, co-work, and co-evolve, says PM Modi at India AI Impact Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of humans and AI co-creating, co-working, and co-evolving at the India AI Impact Summit. He highlighted the need for a mass movement focused on skilling, reskilling, and lifelong learning to prepare workers for upcoming structural changes. This movement aims to equip workers with the necessary skills to adapt to an AI-driven future.

Major AI Developments.title: PM Modi calls to ‘democratise AI’ at India AI Impact Summit; says humans not ‘raw material’
Major AI Developments.summary: PM Narendra Modi spoke at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, referring to AI as a transformative force that should be developed in an inclusive and human-centric manner. He emphasized the need to "democratise AI" and stated that humans should not be treated as "raw material". Modi's remarks highlighted the importance of responsible AI development that prioritizes human well-being.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit: French President Macron calls for for AI sovereignty, warns against data extraction by foreign players
Major AI Developments.summary: French President Macron emphasized the need for AI sovereignty and warned against data extraction by foreign entities. He discussed this issue with Indian Prime Minister Modi, focusing on sovereign artificial intelligence and strategic tech cooperation. Macron's comments highlighted concerns about data dependence and the importance of maintaining control over AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: AI in ‘hyper progress’ era, can help emerging economies leapfrog: Google CEO Sundar Pichai
Major AI Developments.summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai believes AI is in a "hyper progress" era, with the potential to transform various sectors. He thinks AI can help emerging economies leapfrog, bringing significant benefits. Pichai noted that no technology has inspired him to "dream bigger" than AI, due to its vast transformative potential.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s AI opportunity is amazing: Sam Altman
Major AI Developments.summary: Sam Altman described India as a rapidly growing AI market with over 100 million weekly ChatGPT users at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. He announced the 'OpenAI for India' initiative to build local AI infrastructure and skills. The initiative is in partnership with the Tata Group, aiming to leverage India's AI potential.

Major AI Developments.title: Galgotias controversy shouldn’t overshadow efforts at India AI summit: Meity secy on Chinese robot row
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian government ordered the removal of Galgotias Institute's stalls from an expo after a controversy involving a Chinese robot. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (Meity) secretary downplayed the incident, stating it should not overshadow the efforts at the India AI summit. The secretary emphasized the importance of focusing on the event's purpose rather than creating unnecessary noise.

Major AI Developments.title: AI in Indian companies: Your next boss might be a chief AI officer.
Major AI Developments.summary: Indian companies have made significant investments in AI leadership, with at least 50 senior AI-focused hires announced in the past 12 months. This trend suggests a growing importance of AI in Indian businesses, potentially leading to the emergence of chief AI officers. The increasing presence of AI leaders may indicate a shift in company structures, with AI playing a more central role in decision-making.

Major AI Developments.title: Qualcomm chief pledges $150mn fund for AI startups in India visit
Major AI Developments.summary: Qualcomm's chief has announced a $150 million fund for AI startups during a visit to India. The fund will be operated by Qualcomm Ventures, the company's venture capital division. The strategic AI ventures fund will be made available to support AI startups in India.

Major AI Developments.title: Vinod Khosla predicts AI will kill Indian IT sector in five years
Major AI Developments.summary: Vinod Khosla, a veteran venture capitalist, predicts that AI will significantly impact the Indian IT sector, potentially killing it within five years. He suggests making AI a public-sector utility to democratize its capabilities in India. This move could help spread the benefits of AI technology across the country.

Major AI Developments.title: Algorithm action: AI platforms disrupt silver screen at India AI Film Festival
Major AI Developments.summary: AI platforms showcased at the India AI Film Festival aim to reduce production costs and make filmmaking more accessible. This development is expected to democratize the film industry, but also raises concerns about significant job losses. The impact could be substantial, given India's status as the world's largest film industry.

Major AI Developments.title: EXCLUSIVE: India AI Impact Summit - Will AI replace jobs? Zoho Founder Sridhar Vembu's take on India’s AI transition | WATCH
Major AI Developments.summary: Zoho Founder Sridhar Vembu expressed uncertainty about AI's impact on jobs, citing past tech shifts that created new opportunities. He emphasized the importance of experimentation, adaptability, and open-mindedness as India prepares for AI-driven changes. Vembu's comments come as India navigates its transition to an AI-driven economy.

Major AI Developments.title: Google's new project in India REVEALED: Tech giant announces fiber-optic link routes between India-US | Deal details HERE
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has announced a new project in India, which includes a $30 million pledge through Google.org to advance AI research and improve public services. The investment aims to accelerate innovation and support global scientific research in artificial intelligence. The project also involves establishing fiber-optic link routes between India and the US.

Major AI Developments.title: India, France share "same objective" on AI innovation, not "totally dependent" on US, Chinese models: Macron
Major AI Developments.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron stated that India and France share the same objective on AI innovation, seeking to avoid total dependence on US and Chinese models. Macron emphasized the need for a balanced and sovereign approach to emerging technologies. India and France aim to collaborate on AI development, reducing reliance on dominant US and Chinese models.

Major AI Developments.title: AI on cloud moves from pilots to enterprise scale as leaders push for process redesign, data readiness and measurable outcomes
Major AI Developments.summary: Executives from top companies, including Wipro and TCS, discussed the challenges of implementing AI on cloud at the ETCIO Cloud Summit. They noted that AI projects often fail due to weak orchestration, unclear KPIs, and legacy foundations, rather than issues with the models themselves. To achieve enterprise-scale AI, leaders are focusing on process redesign, data readiness, and measurable outcomes.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Trust in the age of synthetic media
Major AI Developments.summary: Policymakers and industry leaders discussed the challenge of synthetic media in India, focusing on building trust without stifling innovation. The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (CTPA) was highlighted as a potential solution, using cryptographic metadata to verify content origin. Leaders from MeitY, Google, Adobe, and ITI participated in the discussions at the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: How infrastructure limits digital growth
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 discussed how infrastructure limitations hinder digital growth, particularly with AI facilities compressing years of demand into months. This rapid acceleration forces utilities and regulators to rethink infrastructure design and deployment. The mismatch between quickly scalable AI capacity and slower grid development poses a significant challenge for synchronization between digital ambitions and grid readiness.

Major AI Developments.title: “End-to-end AI” films are here: Kuku’s AI Impact summit demo hints at a content flood
Major AI Developments.summary: Kuku FM's CEO, Lal Chand Bisu, unveiled India's first "AI-first micro drama" at the AI Impact Summit 2026. This demo hints at the emergence of "end-to-end AI" films, suggesting a potential flood of AI-generated content. The unveiling marks a significant milestone in the integration of AI in the entertainment industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Moving past Galgotias row, desi tech emerges real showstopper at AI Impact Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Impact Summit showcased indigenous innovation in AI, featuring universities and startups demonstrating AI-powered drones, robotics, and full-stack robotics. Education-focused initiatives and grassroots STEM programs were also highlighted, emphasizing practical application and hands-on learning. The summit moved beyond recent controversies, such as the Galgotias robot dog incident, to focus on homegrown tech advancements.

Major AI Developments.title: Opportunity is bigger than before, says Infosys chairman Nilekani on disruption posed by GenAI tools
Major AI Developments.summary: Infosys chairman Nandan Nilekani believes the disruption caused by GenAI tools will create new opportunities for IT services. A lag in enterprise adoption of AI is expected to drive fresh demand, despite investor anxiety and pressure on tech stocks. Nilekani sees this as a bigger opportunity than before for the industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Bharat-VISTAAR launches today- All about the AI tool to help farmers via a simple phone call
Major AI Developments.summary: Bharat-VISTAAR, a multilingual AI tool, has been launched to support Indian agriculture. The tool integrates AgriStack portals and ICAR practices to enhance productivity for farmers. It allows farmers to access information and assistance through a simple phone call.

Major AI Developments.title: Day one of India’s global AI pitch descends into chaos
Major AI Developments.summary: India's premier AI summit began in chaos due to security lockdowns and network failures. International attendees and exhibitors were frustrated by the disruptions on the first day of the event. The issues marred the country's attempt to showcase its AI capabilities on a global stage.

Major AI Developments.title: Ottonomy showcases Made-in-India Autonomous Delivery Ecosystem at India AI Impact Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Ottonomy has showcased its Made-in-India Autonomous Delivery Ecosystem at the India AI Impact Summit. The ecosystem features Ottonomy's Level-4 autonomous delivery robots, called 'Ottobots', which integrate with smart storage infrastructure and drone logistics capabilities. This integrated system aims to enhance delivery efficiency through autonomous technology.

Major AI Developments.title: Market for apps, funding pitches to precede policy declaration at AI summit
Major AI Developments.summary: India's AI Impact Summit will feature a market for apps and funding pitches, aiming to attract global investors and businesses for data centres and AI applications. The event will showcase Indian startups and private enterprises working on AI to a global audience. This will be a key focus of the summit, given the current lack of a binding international coalition on AI.

Major AI Developments.title: India can play a key role in shaping global AI rulebook
Major AI Developments.summary: India can play a crucial role in shaping the global AI rulebook due to its large population and significant data generation. The country is home to over 1.4 billion people and generates around 20% of the world's data. India also has the second-largest AI talent base globally and over 700 million digitally connected citizens.

Major AI Developments.title: Infosys, Anthropic partner to build AI tools for complex, regulated industries
Major AI Developments.summary: Infosys has partnered with Anthropic to develop AI tools for complex and regulated industries. The collaboration aims to automate complex workflows and accelerate software delivery while ensuring governance and transparency. This partnership will help enterprises in regulated industries adopt AI with confidence.

Major AI Developments.title: Razorpay becomes India payments partner for Replit’s global AI platform
Major AI Developments.summary: Razorpay has partnered with Replit to become the India payments partner for its global AI platform, enabling seamless subscription payments and monetization of AI-built products. The integration allows AI-built products to accept UPI payments from the start. Replit will use Razorpay's International Payments Suite to allow Indian users to pay in INR via methods like UPI and cards.

Major AI Developments.title: Summit should establish India as leading AI player globally: NITI Aayog’s Anna...
Major AI Developments.summary: NITI Aayog's Anna Roy suggests that a summit should position India as a leading global player in artificial intelligence. The goal is to establish India's prominence in the AI sector on a global scale. This move aims to showcase India's capabilities and advancements in AI technology.

Major AI Developments.title: French President Emmanuel Macron arrives in India for AI Impact summit, bilateral talks
Major AI Developments.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has arrived in India to attend the AI Impact summit and engage in bilateral talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The discussions will aim to strengthen strategic ties between the two countries and explore new areas of cooperation. Key areas of focus will include emerging technologies, particularly artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Summit may issue declaration for democratised AI
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Summit is expected to issue a declaration calling for greater democratisation of AI resources. The declaration will also advocate for a standardised framework for AI deployment across sectors. A global creative commons regime for AI is also anticipated to be part of the joint statement.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Centre seeks to make every citizen AI-ready
Major AI Developments.summary: India is working to make every citizen AI-ready by connecting every village with high-speed internet through significant investments in 5G and fiber optics. The country's digital infrastructure is attracting global investors, with broadband subscribers surging dramatically as AI reaches rural areas. Network security and data protection measures are also being strengthened to support this initiative.

Major AI Developments.title: AI is a big opportunity for India, not a threat for businesses
Major AI Developments.summary: Artificial intelligence presents significant opportunities for Indian companies, rather than posing a threat to businesses. Indian professionals are expected to deploy AI globally, offering a major chance for the nation, with roles evolving rather than resulting in job losses. The government and private sectors are training 1.5 lakh people in AI to capitalize on this opportunity.

Major AI Developments.title: Niti Aayog member flags AI as key to healthcare overhaul in India
Major AI Developments.summary: Niti Aayog member highlights AI as a crucial factor in transforming India's healthcare system, enhancing primary care and disease surveillance. AI can aid in early diagnosis and improve healthcare outcomes. Collaboration between government, academia, and industry is necessary for developing effective AI solutions in healthcare.

Major AI Developments.title: India eyes investments worth $200 billion in data centres: Ashwini Vaishnaw at AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: India aims to attract $200 billion in investments for data centres, according to Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. The government seeks to develop India into a world-class data hub, covering all five layers of the AI technology stack. This includes infrastructure, computing, storage, applications, and energy requirements to support the growth of the sector.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Summit: Amitabh Kant says current AI models may deepen inequality, calls for inclusive approach for Global South
Major AI Developments.summary: Amitabh Kant warned that current AI models may exacerbate inequality, emphasizing the need for an inclusive approach. He stressed that AI deployment should improve lives and promote inclusive growth for people in the Global South. Kant's comments came as AI adoption continues to accelerate globally, highlighting the importance of equitable technology use.

Major AI Developments.title: PM Modi calls India AI Impact Expo 2026 powerful convergence
Major AI Developments.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised the India AI Impact Expo 2026 as a powerful convergence of talent and innovation. He reaffirmed India's commitment to responsible and inclusive Artificial Intelligence during the event. The Expo saw strong global participation, highlighting India's growing presence in the AI sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Writing code will not be main goal in AI era: Infosys Chairman
Major AI Developments.summary: Infosys Chairman Nandan Nilekani stated that artificial intelligence will revolutionize software development, shifting the primary task for tech professionals away from coding. According to Nilekani, companies must adapt to this change by focusing on institutional transformation, acquiring new skills, and adopting AI. This shift is expected to address growing concerns about industry disruption caused by AI.

Major AI Developments.title: India contributes 16 per cent of world AI talent, white paper reveals
Major AI Developments.summary: India is home to 16% of the world's AI talent, according to a recent white paper. The country is expected to play a significant role in global economic growth, potentially contributing nearly 20% of incremental global GDP growth over the next 15 years. This highlights India's growing importance in the global AI landscape and its potential for future economic impact.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s IT sector is successfully navigating GenAI transition
Major AI Developments.summary: India's IT sector is successfully transitioning to Generative AI, which is boosting productivity and altering job roles without causing widespread job losses. Hiring is moderating at entry levels, while demand for hybrid skills is increasing. The IT industry expects net job growth driven by global AI demand, with evolving roles and skill needs.

Major AI Developments.title: India gears up for global dialogue on artificial intelligence
Major AI Developments.summary: India is preparing for a global dialogue on artificial intelligence, aiming to be a key architect of responsible AI solutions. A report by Nasscom found that responsible AI is becoming a strategic priority for Indian enterprises, linked with trust, governance, and long-term value creation. Indian companies are moving beyond ethical intent to prioritize responsible AI implementation.

Major AI Developments.title: Voice AI startup Ringg AI raises $5.5 Mn in Series A funding led by Arkam Ventures
Major AI Developments.summary: Ringg AI, a Bengaluru-based voice AI startup, has raised $5.5 million in a Series A funding round led by Arkam Ventures. The funding round also saw participation from other investors, including Groww Founder Fund and Kunal Shah. The startup plans to use the fresh capital to expand its teams, accelerate product development, and strengthen its international presence.

Major AI Developments.title: Google’s Gemini Signs IPL Sponsorship Deal Worth ₹270 Crore
Major AI Developments.summary: Google's Gemini has signed a sponsorship deal with the Indian Premier League (IPL) worth ₹270 crore. This move indicates that AI-driven brands are increasingly competing with established companies for high-profile cricket sponsorships. The deal highlights the growing presence of AI-driven brands in major sporting events.

Major AI Developments.title: AI, chip manufacturing to create new jobs by 2030: MeitY Secretary
Major AI Developments.summary: India's electronics sector is expected to experience a jobs boom by 2030, driven by artificial intelligence and new semiconductor manufacturing units. The industry is projected to hire nearly 4.5 million individuals, with a rise in application development jobs. India aims to become a top semiconductor manufacturing nation, with commercial production set to start soon.

Major AI Developments.title: Graph technology & AI trends 2026: India’s AI race - Strong momentum, slow payoff
Major AI Developments.summary: India's AI journey is shifting from experimental to real-world applications, with AI agents requiring human guidance by 2026. Context engineering and smarter data retrieval will be crucial for accuracy, while graph databases and adaptive systems will support AI growth. This will enable responsible and scalable AI deployment across various sectors in India.

Major AI Developments.title: Share your AI journey: OpenAI is spotlighting India’s breakthrough builders
Major AI Developments.summary: OpenAI, in partnership with YourStory, has launched a nationwide campaign in India to discover and spotlight innovative AI builders. The initiative aims to highlight developers, students, and founders who are using OpenAI tools to create real-world impact. The campaign seeks to showcase India's most exciting AI breakthroughs and success stories.

Major AI Developments.title: ElevenLabs Appoints Karthik Rajaram as India Country Head
Major AI Developments.summary: ElevenLabs has appointed Karthik Rajaram as its India Country Head, tasked with leading the company's go-to-market strategy and driving revenue growth in the region. Rajaram's appointment aims to propel the company's expansion in India. He will oversee the development and implementation of strategies to increase revenue and market presence.

Major AI Developments.title: The applied AI factory of the world: India’s role in the global AI order
Major AI Developments.summary: India's AI journey faces challenges, including limited access to compute, lagging investment in AI R&D and infrastructure, and a needed cultural shift in talent readiness and boardroom conviction. Despite these hurdles, India is positioned to play a significant role in the global AI order. India's growth in AI is constrained by these factors, which must be addressed to reach its full potential.

Major AI Developments.summary: AXISCADES' subsidiary Mistral has secured a ₹100 crore order for a defence radar subsystem. Major AI Developments.summary: Viasat is partnering with BSNL to support an upgrade of the Indian Navy's satellite communications. Major AI Developments.summary: Al Qaeda is leveraging AI and deepfake technology to expand its operations in India, aiming for a pan-India presence. Major AI Developments.summary: India is experiencing a rapid expansion of AI-led data centres despite facing challenges related to power and policy. AI Start-Up News.summary: Astranova Mobility, an EV financing and asset management platform, has raised Rs 60 crore in a Series A funding round led by IvyCap Ventures. AI Start-Up News.title: Gabify raises $175K in pre-seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: Gabify, a healthtech startup focused on neurodevelopmental care, has raised $175,000 in a pre-seed funding round led by Inflection Point Ventures.
