AI Start-Up News.title: Don’t panic, AI won’t take your job; AI startup Neysa’s $1.2B funding
AI Start-Up News.summary: Sanjeev Bhikchandani believes historical trends suggest concerns over large-scale job losses due to AI are exaggerated. AI startup Neysa has received $1.2B in funding, amidst ongoing debate about AI's impact on employment in India. This development highlights the growing presence of AI in the job market, but Bhikchandani's comments aim to alleviate fears of widespread job displacement.

AI Start-Up News.title: What Neysa AI’s $1.2 billion raise means for Indian startups and AI policy?
AI Start-Up News.summary: Neysa AI's $1.2 billion funding is a significant boost to India's AI infrastructure ambitions. The investment is expected to expand domestic GPU capacity and reduce reliance on global cloud providers. This development could position India as a major player in the global artificial intelligence ecosystem.

AI Start-Up News.title: Peak XV invests in five early stage AI companies at Impact AI PitchFest
AI Start-Up News.summary: Peak XV has invested in five early-stage AI companies, including Companion Labs, Kello, Memfold AI, Round1, and Zoop, at the Impact AI PitchFest held during the India AI Impact Summit 2026. The investments were announced after founders presented to investors and ecosystem leaders at the event. These startups aim to develop innovative AI solutions, such as interactive entertainment experiences and other specialized services.

AI Start-Up News.title: ValleyNXT Ventures floats Rs 400 Cr fund to back seed- to pre-Series A startups
AI Start-Up News.summary: ValleyNXT Ventures has launched a Rs 400 crore fund, Bharat Breakthrough Fund-I, to support seed to pre-Series A startups. The fund aims to address the challenges faced by startups during the validation and scale phase through a unique VC-plus-accelerator model. The model is powered by ValleyNXT's MIB framework, which includes mentorship, investment, and business connects.

AI Start-Up News.title: From 300ms latency to 30,000 concurrent calls: Inside India's voice AI production systems
AI Start-Up News.summary: India's voice AI production systems have made significant advancements, reducing latency from 300ms to near real-time and increasing capacity to 30,000 concurrent calls. A recent webinar by YourStory featured E2E Networks, Nvidia, and Gnani.ai, showcasing their approaches to deploying voice AI at scale. The discussion covered topics such as GPU instance management and handling complex code-mixed conversations.

AI Start-Up News.title: No DeepSeek-like splash: India will showcase small AI, early startups at Summit
AI Start-Up News.summary: India's AI Impact Summit will feature early-stage, small AI models and startups, rather than large-scale breakthroughs like DeepSeek. The focus will be on an enterprise-first approach to foundational AI, indicating a cautious strategy. This approach will be taken by both startups and policymakers at the summit.

AI Start-Up News.title: Uptiq raises $25M in Series B funding, plans expansion of India research hub
AI Start-Up News.summary: Uptiq has raised $25M in Series B funding to expand its operations. The new capital will be used to scale research, engineering capacity, and develop production-grade AI systems for regulated financial environments. The company also plans to expand its research hub in India as part of its growth strategy.

AI Start-Up News.title: ThirdAI raises $3 Mn led by Endiya Partners and Capria Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: Deeptech startup ThirdAI has raised $3 million in a seed funding round co-led by Endiya Partners and Capria Ventures. The company plans to use the fresh capital to scale product development, expand its teams, and accelerate deployments with semiconductor toolmakers and fabrication facilities. ThirdAI is an India-US-based company building a causal AI-powered platform for root cause analysis and troubleshooting in semiconductor manufacturing.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI software testing startup BotGauge AI raises $2 Mn led by Surface Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: BotGauge AI, a software testing startup, has raised $2 million in funding led by Surface Ventures, with participation from IA Seed Ventures and Saka Ventures. The fresh capital will be used to strengthen product development, expand the engineering team, and scale operations in international markets. The company, founded in 2024, builds a software testing platform that uses autonomous AI agents to automate quality assurance processes.

AI Start-Up News.title: India's sovereign AI models outperform global giants like ChatGPT
AI Start-Up News.summary: India's homegrown AI models are achieving global success, with government-backed startup Sarvam developing tools that outperform major international players. Sarvam's AI models are surpassing the capabilities of global giants like ChatGPT. This milestone marks a significant achievement for India's AI industry, showcasing its potential to compete with international leaders.

AI Start-Up News.title: Sarvam AI : Why this AI model is gaining attention? Know full story here
AI Start-Up News.summary: Sarvam AI has emerged as a prominent player in India's AI ecosystem under the leadership of co-founder and CEO Pratyush Kumar. The company is developing foundational AI technologies that are competitive with international counterparts. Sarvam AI's innovations are gaining attention for their potential to drive growth and advancement in the field.

AI Start-Up News.title: Java Capital launches Rs 400 Cr fund to back seed-stage deeptech startups
AI Start-Up News.summary: Java Capital has launched a Rs 400 crore fund to invest in seed-stage deeptech startups, focusing on IP-led technology businesses across various sectors. The fund will target companies in areas such as semiconductors, cybersecurity, AI infrastructure, and climate tech, among others. It plans to invest in 15-20 startups over the next three to four years, with initial cheques ranging from Rs 6-8 crore.

AI Start-Up News.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Feb 02 - Feb 07]
AI Start-Up News.summary: 26 Indian startups raised around $215 million in funding this week, with 3 growth-stage and 18 early-stage deals. Five startups kept their funding amounts undisclosed. This amount is lower than the $354 million secured by 47 startups in the previous week.

AI Start-Up News.title: How Kentrix.ai Is Helping Brands Rethink GTM Strategies Using Granular Data And AI
AI Start-Up News.summary: Kentrix.ai is helping brands rethink their go-to-market (GTM) strategies using granular data and AI. The company's technology assists in making informed decisions, such as identifying ideal locations for setting up retail outlets like petrol pumps. By leveraging data and AI, Kentrix.ai enables brands to optimize their GTM strategies and improve overall performance.

AI Start-Up News.title: All In Capital launches Golden Ticket program for early-stage AI SaaS founders
AI Start-Up News.summary: All In Capital has launched its Golden Ticket program to support early-stage Indian founders building AI-led and vertical SaaS companies. The program will select 20-30 startups for pre-seed funding of up to $300K per company, with a total capital deployment of up to $1 million. The selected startups will participate in a demo day as part of the program.

AI Start-Up News.title: This new AI tool can help you book train tickets, get refunds and check details on IRCTC website and app
AI Start-Up News.summary: Indian Railways has introduced an AI chatbot called AskDisha 2.0, powered by CoRover.AI, to assist with various tasks on the IRCTC website and app. The chatbot can help users book tickets, get refunds, check PNR status, and more using text or voice commands in multiple languages. It offers a range of services, including cancelling tickets, changing boarding stations, and accessing e-tickets.

AI Start-Up News.title: Antler is doubling its checks and speed amidst the flurry of AI companies in India
AI Start-Up News.summary: Antler is adjusting its strategy amidst the growing AI industry in India, focusing on quality founders and ideas by reducing cohort size. The firm plans to onboard new cohorts every quarter to keep pace with the evolving AI landscape. This shift comes after Antler announced its AI residency programme in July 2025.

AI Start-Up News.title: India has seen a 3X increase in number of GenAI startups in 2025: Economic Survey
AI Start-Up News.summary: India saw a threefold increase in the number of GenAI startups in 2025, according to the Economic Survey. Cumulative funding for these startups rose to $990 million in the first half of 2025, up from $758 million in the same period the previous year. This growth has made GenAI a spotlight sector in India's deeptech ecosystem.

AI Start-Up News.title: Over 100 Indian AI startup founders moving to US for funds and talent
AI Start-Up News.summary: Over 100 Indian AI startup founders are relocating to the US in search of funding and talent. Several startups, including Composio and Meetstream.ai, have already made the move over the past couple of years. Others, such as Smallest.ai and Beatoven.ai, are also shifting their base to the US.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI film studio TakeTwo secures funding at Rs 100 Cr valuation in pre-seed round
AI Start-Up News.summary: TakeTwo, an AI-native film studio, has secured funding at a valuation of Rs 100 crore in its pre-seed round, with participation from US-based Afore Capital and Canada's Inovia VC. The company, founded by Y Combinator's AI Startup School alumni, aims to be a key technology partner for India's film industry. The funding will be used to develop technical infrastructure and scale its team of creative technologists.

AI Start-Up News.title: Would you raise an AI pet? India’s new digital companions are here
AI Start-Up News.summary: India has introduced various AI-powered virtual pet applications, including Pengu, Widgetable, and Pokipet, allowing users to customize their digital companions. These apps utilize AI technology to create interactive and personalized virtual pets. Indians can now experience pet ownership through these digital platforms, such as Cryptkitties and Zumi Chat.

AI Start-Up News.title: What Indian VCs want; AI for the modern classroom
AI Start-Up News.summary: Indian VCs are seeking tailored incentives for deeptech startups and predictable tax frameworks. Fermi.ai has launched an AI-driven education platform in India and the US, aiming to modernize the classroom. The platform is part of a growing trend to integrate AI in education, enhancing the learning experience.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bird’s Eye: How Staqu Tracks And Solves Crime in India with AI
AI Start-Up News.summary: Staqu uses its AI-powered video analytics platform, JARVIS, to track and solve crime in India. JARVIS analyzes live and recorded camera feeds to provide insights. The platform is a key offering from Staqu, leveraging AI to enhance crime-solving capabilities.

AI Start-Up News.title: Ex-Google Executive Peeyush Ranjan Launches AI EdTech Startup Fermi.ai in India & USA
AI Start-Up News.summary: Former Google executive Peeyush Ranjan has launched Fermi.ai, an AI-first edtech startup focused on transforming high-school STEM education in India and the US. The company, headquartered in Singapore, will roll out its learning platform in both countries, initially covering mathematics, physics, and chemistry. Fermi.ai aims to revolutionize education through its AI-powered platform.

AI Start-Up News.title: IMF applauds india’s digital reforms, sees it shaping global AI
AI Start-Up News.summary: The International Monetary Fund has expressed confidence in India's economic trajectory and its emerging role in artificial intelligence. The IMF has applauded India's digital reforms, recognizing their potential impact on the country's growth. India is expected to play a significant role in shaping the global AI landscape.

AI Start-Up News.title: Wealthy is fuelling the next phase of growth for India’s mutual fund distributors through AI
AI Start-Up News.summary: Wealthy, a technology platform, is driving growth for India's mutual fund distributors by leveraging AI. The platform facilitates client onboarding, portfolio management, and transactions across various investment products. It caters to independent financial advisors in India, streamlining their operations and enhancing their services.

AI Start-Up News.title: 2care.ai aims to transform chronic care management in India through WhatsApp
AI Start-Up News.summary: 2care.ai, a healthtech startup, is using WhatsApp and AI to simplify chronic care management in India. The platform organizes health data, tracks treatment, and supports patients between appointments, with a focus on cancer care. This innovative approach aims to transform the way chronic care is managed in the country.
